notes.subject: fix(deps): unblock the grouped Dependabot npm update
notes.summary: Fixes Dependabot override resolution for dompurify and normalizes a missing keychain entry (null from newer @napi-rs/keyring) to undefined so secret reads behave consistently.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): scroll the whole sidebar and fold secondary panels under Settings
notes.summary: The Assistant sidebar now scrolls as one region and GitHub, MCP, Memory, Assistant settings and Setup move into an inline Settings expansion, leaving Jobs, Inbox, Tasks and Settings as a 2x2 hub.

notes.subject: feat(desktop): sign release builds so macOS permissions survive updates
notes.summary: Desktop releases are now signed with an Apple Development certificate so macOS Local Network and Keychain permissions persist across updates, and the in-app updater accepts signed releases while still allowing unsigned ones.

notes.subject: fix(desktop): left-align view tabs and badge the Assistant tab inside the Assistant
notes.summary: Desktop view tabs are now left-aligned, and the Assistant tab shows its own unread badge when viewed inside the Assistant.

notes.subject: fix(webview): flush buffered text before thinking blocks start
notes.summary: Text streamed before a thinking block is now flushed first, so it no longer gets split around the thinking block in the chat view.

notes.subject: fix(desktop): match Assistant zoom to the shell and show a loading spinner on its tab
notes.summary: The Desktop Assistant view now matches the shell's zoom and sidebar alignment, and its sidebar tab shows a loading spinner while the Assistant connects.

notes.subject: feat(desktop): allow Assistant notifications for the paired Assistant page
notes.summary: The Desktop app now allows notifications for the paired Assistant page only, and the page explains a refusal in desktop terms instead of pointing to browser site settings.
